newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan moved in a narrow range in dull trading above 8.2980 on Thursday and ended at 8.2977 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, slightly up from Wednesday's 8.2980, traders said.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2975 and moved in a range between an intra-day high of 8.2974 and a low of 8.2980 for the whole session.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2977, traders said.
Dealers said that buyers and sellers had little interest in trading before the end of the year, which confined the yuan's movement.
"There were bids at about 8.2980 which supported the yuan," said one dealer. "But they seemed to have no intention of pushing the yuan up further, with the year-end approaching."
A second dealer said that most banks stayed on the sidelines because of the unclear direction of the currency. He said he expects the yuan to continue moving around 8.2980 on Friday.
The yuan closed slightly up at 7.2100 from 7.2350 against 100 Japanese yen and was unchanged at an intra-day low of 1.0720 against the Hong Kong dollar.
